statement: On newly published Indus seals from sites in South Asia (not the Gulf, Iran, Central Asia or Mesopotamia), seals whose text contains G55 (twelve strokes, 4/4/4) show the gaur more often than other seals with a known animal from the same publications.
data: Seals absent from ICIT (as of the project's merged copy), first published after 26 October 2026, with the animal identified by the publication.
test: one-sided Fisher exact, alpha 0.05; evaluate only when at least 5 new G55 seals with a known animal exist
falsified_if: with 5 or more new G55 seals, the gaur share is not higher than among the other new seals
